reason: The pallet is buried, so using the hand winch there seems like a practical way to free the array.
expectation: I expect the winch to pull the pallet free or make it accessible, though it may need an anchor or other preparation first.

alternatives.reason: The service tool might open or dismantle the shipping frame, but freeing the buried pallet seems like the more immediate goal.

effect: The array is free, but it needs broader feet to stand on loose ground before it can power the cabin.
reaction: The salvaged frame makes the next step feel practical, and the explanation of why the brackets would sink is useful.
reason: The service tool and shipping frame are the only combination offered, and the frame has material for the array's feet.
expectation: I expect to salvage usable parts from the frame, though I don't know whether this will make the feet directly.

effect: The frame yielded metal stock for both the array’s feet and later workshop use, so I can now fit the feet.
reaction: I like that the salvaged material has a clear purpose beyond this immediate repair.
reason: Combining the stock with the recovered array is the only offered combination and should help stabilize it on the loose ground.
expectation: I expect to add broad mounting feet to the array, though it may still need positioning or wiring.

effect: The metal stock turned the recovered array into a standing array, so connecting power is the next apparent step.
reaction: Seeing the array stand is a satisfying result of making the broader feet.
reason: The power lead and standing array are the only combination offered, and connecting them seems necessary to power the cabin.
expectation: I expect the lead to connect the array to the cabin, though another connection may be needed.

effect: The power lead completed the solar power rack and powered the cabin, completing the chapter’s goals.
reaction: The fan returning to its ordinary note makes the repair feel tangible and satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the salvaged metal to the array was most worthwhile: the explanation of broad feet spreading weight on loose ground made the repair understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the power lead was straightforward, though it offered little decision-making because it was the only combination available.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the shipping frame supplied both mounting feet and stock for later workshop use.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear practical purpose, though most steps offered only one combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because I’m curious how the remaining stock will be used and how the expedition develops, although I hope for more decisions.
